name: pinchflat
title: Pinchflat
description: Keeps YouTube channels and playlists downloaded: it checks them on a schedule and saves new videos in a folder layout Jellyfin, Plex and Kodi understand, or serves them as a podcast feed. After deploying, make a media profile first (it decides quality and file names), then add a channel or playlist as a source. It has no sign-in of its own.

variables.name: PINCHFLAT_DOWNLOADS
variables.label: Download folder
variables.description: The folder on this server the videos are saved in, mounted at /downloads; add it to your media server as a library
